mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO jutsu_episode ( slug, season, episode, label, relative_url, paywalled, discovered_at, last_seen_at ) VALUES
(#{ep.slug}, #{ep.season}, #{ep.episode}, #{ep.label}, #{ep.relativeUrl}, #{ep.paywalled}, #{ep.discoveredAt}, #{ep.lastSeenAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label = VALUES(label), relative_url = VALUES(relative_url), paywalled = COALESCE(VALUES(paywalled), paywalled), discovered_at = COALESCE(discovered_at, VALUES(discovered_at)), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
